description: Shows how many free calls are left today and the prepaid credit balance (with roughly how many paid calls it covers), plus any top-up still waiting for payment. Use when the user asks what's left, or after `topup` to see whether a payment has arrived; to add credit, use `topup` instead. Reads the key in the server URL if there is one, otherwise the free calls for this connection. Free to call. Pass `code` to redeem a credit code (ac_…) we gave back for an empty result: it's added to the key's balance (a new key is made if there isn't one).

code.description: Optional: a credit code to redeem, e.g. ac_0123456789abcdef01234567.

name: balance

apiKey.description: A new API key, when a code was redeemed without one (shown once).

approxPaidCalls.description: Roughly how many $0.01 calls the balance covers.

balanceUsd.description: Prepaid credit left, in US dollars (only with a key).

calls.description: Paid calls made with this key so far.

credits.description: Null when the server URL has no API key.

freeTrial.description: Free calls left today (null if the free trial couldn't be checked or is off).

perKey.description: True when counted for the API key in the server URL.

resets.description: When the free calls reset (00:00 UTC).

lowBalance.description: True when the balance is running low.

recentCalls.description: The latest paid calls with their cost.

redeemedUsd.description: Credit added from a redeemed code.

serverUrl.description: The server URL with the new key.

topups.description: Recent top-ups (open, paid or expired), newest first.

title: Free calls and balance left (free to call)
